Class Icon

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent
javafx.scene.layout.Region
net.tessel.fx.icons.Icon
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class Icon extends javafx.scene.layout.Region
A vector glyph from the Tessel icon set. By default it is drawn in the text color of the control that contains it (for example white on an accent button); call setColor(Color) for a fixed color. 
button.setGraphic(new Icon(Symbol.SAVE));
button.setGraphic(new Icon(Symbol.SETTINGS, 20));
